[USER] User is intrigued by the Salted Caramel Chocolate Crinkle Cookies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for achieving the crinkled surface:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Use high-quality flaky sea salt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Chill the dough for at least 2 hours or overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Roll dough balls gently to compress slightly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Coat evenly in sugar and salt mixture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Don't over-sugar the dough balls.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Bake at 375°F (190°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Don't overbake; remove when lightly golden and soft.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Cool on the baking sheet for 5-7 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
